conventions.origin: last month of data used; features use months <= origin
conventions.horizon: h targets the fatalities in the single calendar month origin + h
conventions.series: total: UCDP best-estimate fatalities, all three violence types summed
conventions.probabilities: P(fatalities >= k) for k in 1, 25, 100; monotone across k
conventions.risers: change in next-month P(>=25) versus the next-month forecast from the previous origin, recomputed from the current data truncated at that origin
